docs.title: Released projects
docs.text: These are mostly games available from gamejams. Since I tend to prototype or work on bigger projects when I work on personal projects.

docs.title: Puff Puff Push
docs.text: A game originally made in 2 days for the dingo gamejam in Godot. it's a simple king of the hill game which can be played with up to 8 players and the control scheme is a joystick and a single button. you can play it here

docs.title: Haunted
docs.text: A game made in one week for the Godot Wild Jam #74 in Godot. It's technially a 3D game with 2D assets in a hand painted style. you can play it here

docs.title: Others...
docs.text: you can look at all my released games on my itch.io profile Cedric45

docs.title: Nightmare Internship
docs.text: An Unreal Engine 5 story game I made for a school project. I never released it since I thought the gameplay was too boring. However, It does look pretty nice

docs.title: Floppy Code
docs.text: An Unreal Engine 5 game I made to learn the engine. It's pretty much flappy bird but in 3D. I didn't release it since I felt it didn't add anything to the flappy bird formula.

docs.title: Labubu Hell
docs.text: An Unity game I made for a school assignment. I had zero experience in Unity when making this game, but since I had alot of experience in game making, I made this game in about 8-10 hours. It's basically just dodging random objects and jumping on the head of enemies, I was focusing on learning Unreal instead of unity at the time so I didn't want to spend alot of time on unity

docs.title: Who am I?
docs.text:
My name is cedric Champoux, I am a gamer first, and a programmer second.

I've always enjoyed technology, and it always impresses me whenever new things come out.

I've grown with the games, softwares and hardwares created by those who came before me. One day, I hope to be part of the creation of amazing things too.

docs.title: How I work in a team
Integration
docs.text: When joining a team, I'm very carefull about following the rules, policies, design philosophies and tasks which the team has undertaken. I achieve this by reading documentation, asking alot of questions and visualing the patterns of my pairs. My philosophy is that I am a cog in a machine, and I need to adapt to fit inside the machine.

docs.title: Socially
docs.text: I know the importance of a team's mood and motivation to a product's development. Therefore, I always treat my colleagues with respects and kindness. If I have a complain about a colleague's work, I will go discuss it with them and explain my reasoning in a kind manner.

docs.title: Strengths
docs.text: These are the traits which - Researching and planning - Adapting to new technologies - Creative - Charismatic
